armando-urteaga.text: Endorsed by the Whittier Secondary Education Association (the WUHSD teachers' union) and the Los Angeles County Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO.

armando-urteaga.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party.

armando-urteaga.text: In his 2026 candidate statement, Urteaga said he remains dedicated to "creating safe, innovative schools, maintaining fiscal responsibility, and preparing students for college, career, and life," citing his 20 years on the East Whittier board working to "strengthen fiscal stewardship."

source.title: Urteaga for WUHSD School Board 2026: Candidate Statement

armando-urteaga.text: His campaign bio says he is "committed to ensuring that all students have access to high-quality educational opportunities and district resources, particularly for students in special education and English learner populations."

source.title: Urteaga for WUHSD School Board 2026: About Armando

armando-urteaga.text: On his January 2026 appointment, Urteaga said he looks forward to "collaboration with our union organizations and District leaders, and policies that meet the needs of our diverse student population."

source.title: Whittier Daily News: Whittier Union board of trustees appoints Armando Urteaga to open seat (Feb. 2026)

desiree-g-quintero.text: Her campaign site's mission statement: "My mission is to bring equality and opportunity to all students in WUHSD Area 5," advocating "policies that promote academic excellence and personal growth."
